title: Zip Arrays
prompt: A table builder receives separate columns and needs row pairs. Write a function that combines two arrays into pairs, stopping when the shorter array runs out.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Zip Arrays, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A table builder receives separate columns and needs row pairs. Write a function that combines two arrays into pairs, stopping when the shorter array runs out. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
